answer: A Design mockup approved in peer review backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A lone island proves nothing about craft; only the reviewed record counts. A reef alone is noise; a tundra of accepted work is a pattern the network can trust.
